title: Check result
description: What adhd_core returns for one bundle against one slot. Same bundle, same slot, same core version: same result, byte for byte.

core.description: adhd_core version that ran the checks.

bundle_sha256.description: Hash of the canonical submission.json, which pins every file by hash.

verdict.description: pass: every check passed. fail: at least one failed. incomplete: nothing failed but some checks were skipped, e.g. Blender checks run without Blender. Only CI can return a final pass.

id.description: Stable check id, e.g. model.tris, sound.loudness.

measured.description: What was measured, when it is a single value.

fix.description: Plain English: how to fix it. Present on every fail.

where.description: File, prim path or frame the problem is in.
